## Type

- [ ] `feat` — new capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — no behavior change
- [ ] `docs` / `test` / `chore`

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes (added/updated tests for the change)
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] For theme/derivation changes: attached a before/after preview
      (`npx shadcn-theming preview brand.json`)
- [ ] Preserved shadcn token names, ordering, and the dark alpha-white
      `border`/`input` convention
